Package logic

Class Promotion

java.lang.Object
logic.Promotion
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Promotion extends Object implements Serializable
represents one row in the promotions table.

used as the payload for SUBMIT_PROMOTION (from park manager to server), as a read-only row in the department manager's Pending Promotions panel, and as an entry in the GET_ACTIVE_PROMOTIONS response used by the pricing engine.

mirrors logic.Promotion in the server project. keep the two in sync so serialization stays compatible.

    • Promotion

      public Promotion(int parkId, String parkName, String description, double discountPercent, String startDate, String endDate, String submittedBy)
      submission constructor, used by the park manager to package a proposed promotion before sending to the server. id is 0 and status is PENDING; the server assigns the real id and stores the PENDING status on insert.
